summary: Root cause is credential_expiry: payment-service's own mTLS client certificate (CN=payments-client.orangeinvest.internal, notAfter=2026-04-02T12:15:00Z) expired. cert-watcher warned from 08:20Z, but no renewal occurred. From ~12:15Z every bank-partner-api call fails the TLS handshake ('tls: expired certificate (alert 45)'), so fund transfers cannot be submitted and payments are parked as PENDING_RETRY. The HTTP error_rate panel stayed green because those failures are returned as successful (non-5xx) responses, while bank_api_error_rate rose to 100% and payment_success_rate fell from ~99% to ~2.5% at 12:12Z. Deployments (none for payment-service), the unrelated cfg-2502 timeout change, settlement-service dep-5510, bank-side outage, and resource/capacity saturation were all ruled out.

ranked_hypotheses.title: payment-service mTLS client certificate expired, breaking all bank-partner-api calls
ranked_hypotheses.statement: payment-service's mTLS client certificate (CN=payments-client.orangeinvest.internal) expired at 2026-04-02T12:15:00Z. After expiry every call to bank-partner-api fails the TLS handshake (alert 45 expired certificate), so fund transfers cannot be submitted. Failures are swallowed as PENDING_RETRY (HTTP success), leaving the HTTP 5xx error_rate panel green while bank_api_error_rate hits 100% and payment_success_rate collapses.

causal_chain.claim: Client cert notAfter=2026-04-02T12:15:00Z reached; cert-watcher warned since 08:20Z with no renewal
mTLS handshake to bank-partner-api rejected, error 'tls: expired certificate (alert 45)'
Payments marked PENDING_RETRY instead of failing HTTP -> error_rate (5xx) stays flat
bank_api_error_rate rises to 100% and payment_success_rate falls to ~2.5% at 12:12Z

assumptions: The cert was not renewed/rotated by any process after cert-watcher fired.
bank-partner-api itself is healthy; the failure is on our side of the mTLS handshake.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Bank partner API outage (external dependency failure)
ranked_hypotheses.statement: bank-partner-api is degraded/down, causing all payment calls to fail regardless of our certificate.
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: The error is explicitly a TLS handshake rejection citing OUR client certificate ('our client cert CN=payments-client.orangeinvest.internal notAfter=2026-04-02T12:15:00Z') with alert 45 'expired certificate', and cert-watcher pre-warned of the same expiry. A partner-side outage would not produce an expired-our-cert message nor a predictable onset exactly at our cert's notAfter.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Config change cfg-2502 (bank API timeout 3s->5s) caused payment failures
ranked_hypotheses.statement: Raising bank.api.timeout_ms caused bank calls to fail/hang, producing the failures.
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: cfg-2502 at 11:20Z precedes both the cert expiry (12:15Z) and the metric inflection (12:12Z), and a timeout change cannot produce 'tls: expired certificate (alert 45)' referencing a specific cert notAfter. bank_api_error_rate stayed normal (~0.2%) until 12:12Z, i.e. after the config change.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Resource/capacity saturation in payment-service
ranked_hypotheses.statement: CPU, DB connection pool, or traffic saturation caused the failures.
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: cpu_pct (~30%), db_pool_in_use (~8), and request_rate (~100 req/s) are all flat and normal across the window; no saturation. Failure mode is TLS-specific, not load-related.

facts.statement: payment-service client cert expired at 2026-04-02T12:15:00Z with advance cert-watcher warnings from 08:20Z.
bank-partner-api calls failed with TLS 'expired certificate (alert 45)' citing our client cert, and 140 payments went to PENDING_RETRY.
HTTP 5xx error_rate panel stayed flat ~0.2% throughout, masking the incident.
bank_api_error_rate reached 100% and payment_success_rate fell to ~2.5% from 12:12Z.
No payment-service code deployment occurred on 2026-04-02.
Only prior payment-service config change was cfg-2502 (timeout 3000->5000) at 11:20Z, unrelated to TLS cert validity.
CPU, DB pool, and request rate were flat/normal; no resource saturation.
settlement-service logged no errors, so its 10:30Z deploy is not implicated.

assumptions: The client cert was not silently renewed/rotated after the last cert-watcher warning (no evidence of renewal found).
bank-partner-api is otherwise healthy; the handshake failure is attributable to our expired client cert.
PENDING_RETRY payments are recoverable via replay once mTLS works.

recommended_actions.action: Renew/rotate the payment-service client certificate for CN=payments-client.orangeinvest.internal and reload it immediately; confirm bank_api_error_rate returns to ~0 and payment_success_rate recovers.
recommended_actions.rationale: Expired cert is the direct cause of all bank call failures; renewal restores the mTLS handshake.

recommended_actions.action: Drain/replay the PENDING_RETRY payment backlog once mTLS is restored.
recommended_actions.rationale: 140+ transfers are parked awaiting retry and must be completed for customers.

recommended_actions.action: Add or fix alerting on bank_api_error_rate and payment_success_rate (business-level SLIs), not just the HTTP 5xx error_rate panel, so caught-and-retried failures are visible.
recommended_actions.rationale: The green 5xx dashboard masked a full outage; bank/success metrics revealed it.

recommended_actions.action: Automate certificate renewal and page on cert-watcher expiry warnings; enforce an expiry-buffer policy.
recommended_actions.rationale: cert-watcher warned for hours and nothing acted; the same class recurred in HIST-106.

No explicit cert-renewal/rotation audit log was available to prove no renewal attempt was made.
payment-service logs returned truncated=true (40 of 314 rows shown), though top patterns and first-seen times were captured; total counts are consistent.

findings.statement: The HTTP dashboard metric error_rate (unit: % of requests (HTTP 5xx)) stayed flat and normal (~0.18-0.32%) throughout the incident window, never rising.
The bank-facing and business metrics did go red: bank_api_error_rate jumped from ~0.2% to 100% starting 12:12Z, and payment_success_rate collapsed from ~99% to ~2.5%.
No code deployment for payment-service occurred on 2026-04-02 (count 0); the only deployment in scope was settlement-service dep-5510 at 10:30Z.
The only payment-service config change before onset was cfg-2502 raising bank.api.timeout_ms from 3000 to 5000 at 11:20Z — unrelated to TLS certificate validity.
Saturation/resource metrics were flat and normal: cpu_pct ~30%, db_pool_in_use ~8 connections, request_rate ~100 req/s — no resource exhaustion.
settlement-service logged zero errors in the window, so the 10:30Z settlement deploy is not implicated in the payment failures.
Historical incident HIST-106 (Settlement mTLS certificate expired, category credential_expiry) is a close precedent, and HIST-105 is a dependency_failure case for comparison; these are leads only.
